description: This file declares the implementation of an IPC server for the Rialto project, including the ServerImpl class, which manages client connections, message processing, and socket handling within the IPC framework.
external_methods: bool addSocket(const std::string &socketPath, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient> &)> clientConnectedCb, std::function<void(const std::shared_ptr<IClient> &)> clientDisconnectedCb)
